option.name: --force
tip: ignore nonexistent files and arguments, never prompt

option.name: --interactive
tip: prompt according to WHEN: never, once (-I), or always (-i); without WHEN, prompt always

option.name: --one-file-system
tip: when removing a hierarchy recursively, skip any directory that is on a file system different from that of the corresponding command line argument

option.name: --preserve-root
tip: do not remove '/' (default); with 'all', reject any command line argument on a separate device from its parent

option.name: --recursive
tip: remove directories and their contents recursively

option.name: -I
tip: prompt once before removing more than three files, or when removing recursively; less intrusive than -i, while still giving protection against most mistakes
